cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.

cause: The first remediation-3 start invocation passed test strings without shell quoting, so the formal CLI parsed embedded spaces as extra arguments.
impact: The command was rejected before the new formal line or implementation state was created; the retry used one quoted value per CLI option.
lesson: Shell-quote every formal CLI value that contains spaces before invoking start.

cause: The second remediation-3 start invocation used a dotted display tag, but formal tags require normalized identifiers.

lesson: Use normalized hyphenated identifiers for formal tags before starting a line.

cause: The Report owner still trusted an importable module object and accepted a caller-invoked _from_host path without a host-issued report proof.
impact: The authority probe failed as intended before implementation; the legacy importable trust root must be removed before projection, writer, or render admission.
lesson: Bind Report owner admission to the existing host-issued opaque capability, never to an importable module object.

cause: The controlled server-host harness could not bind its real Unix authority socket in the default sandbox.
impact: The authority implementation RED result is separable from the host-permission boundary; the identical harness must be rerun in a controlled socket-capable environment.
lesson: Separate host socket permissions from Report authority behavior and rerun the real host harness with controlled permissions.

cause: The controlled host probe passed the socket boundary but its temporary persistence directory was not created before FD admission.
impact: The failure was in the new harness setup before owner construction; the fixture now creates the directory before admission.
lesson: Create the controlled persistence root before invoking the FD-safe admission seam.

cause: The global Report persistence configuration accepted an object.__new__ copy of a valid owner without rechecking host admission.
impact: A forged owner could become the process-wide Report persistence capability unless configuration validates the live C0 host admission before installation.
lesson: Every Report persistence installation boundary must revalidate the exact host-admitted owner before state mutation.

cause: The Report persistence configuration now revalidates the exact weakly registered C0 host-admitted owner before installing process-wide state.

cause: The controlled server-host harness now issues a Report owner through the admitted host channel, and the owner reaches a canonical projection only after live proof validation.

cause: The identical controlled server-host authority probe passed when rerun with the required socket permission, separating the default sandbox boundary from implementation behavior.
impact: The Unix socket PermissionError is recorded as an environment boundary; the controlled harness is green.
lesson: Record socket/host permission failures separately and rerun the same probe in a controlled environment before judging authority code.

cause: TDD probes for missing outer source, validator, execution, and contract provenance fields failed before the canonical admission guard was implemented.
